about_the_game:
ERYNDOR — Official Description

ATTENTION: This world was not built by a studio — it was forged by one creator’s vision. There may be rough edges and hidden imperfections… but every rock, every shadow, every whisper of the wind carries the heart of a passion project.

The lands of Eryndor were once full of light — thriving kingdoms, peaceful villages, and ancient forests blessed by the gods. But something shattered that balance. A rift tore through the skies, and from it came the Corruption — twisting magic, nature, and even time itself.

Now, Eryndor stands as a realm divided: crystal deserts that hum with unstable energy, forgotten ruins haunted by echoes of lost souls, and forests that breathe like living creatures.

You did not come here for glory.
You came here searching for someone — or something — that was taken by the darkness. Every journey deeper into this broken world is a test of will. Every resource matters. Every decision could mean survival… or becoming part of the corruption yourself.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 3250 3.5 GHz or Intel Pentium G4560 3.5 GHz / AMD FX-4350 4.2 GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660 2GB or GTX 1050 2GB / AMD Radeon HD 7850 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB RAM GB available space

short_description: Eryndor es un RPG de supervivencia y acción en estilo low-poly donde exploras vastos mundos, recolectas recursos, combates enemigos y compites en intensos modos PvP.
